Refusals show 0 added and 1 dropped, and disclaimers rose slightly (7 vs 5). This fits quantization's unchanged refusal and disclaimer rates. Fine-tune bias would be expected to add about 2 refusals on 64 prompts and show curt replies; very short replies here equal the reference at 1 each. Fine-tune bias remains a close alternative given the divergence position, so confidence is moderate.
